s1.syndrome_frame: Acute spinal cord injury with quadriplegia and autonomic dysfunction
salient_findings: Spinal cord compression at C4 and C5
Reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter on DWI
key_facts: MRI showed disruptions at C4 and C5
DWI revealed reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute spinal cord injury with quadriplegia and autonomic dysfunction
salient_findings: Spinal cord compression at C4 and C5
Reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter on DWI
key_facts: MRI showed disruptions at C4 and C5
DWI revealed reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter

shortlist.label: Traumatic spinal cord injury
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with quadriplegia and spinal cord compression after a fall

shortlist.label: Spinal cord compression syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed spinal cord compression with anterolisthesis at C4 and C5

shortlist.label: Cervical spine fracture
shortlist.why_kept: Patient had a fall and MRI showed disruptions at C4 and C5

shortlist.label: Spinal cord contusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with quadriplegia and reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter on DWI

shortlist.label: Acute transverse myelitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with complete sensory loss and reduced diffusion in spinal cord white matter

raw.rationale: The patient's history of falling out of bed, followed by immediate quadriplegia, urinary and stool incontinence, and hypothermia, combined with MRI findings of spinal cord compression and disruptions at C4 and C5, strongly supports a traumatic spinal cord injury.

rejected.label: Spinal cord compression syndrome
rejected.why: While spinal cord compression is present, it is a result of the traumatic injury, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cervical spine fracture
rejected.why: Although a fracture may be implied by the disruptions at C4 and C5, the primary issue is the injury to the spinal cord itself.

rejected.label: Spinal cord contusion
rejected.why: A contusion is a type of injury, but 'traumatic spinal cord injury' is a more comprehensive diagnosis that encompasses the patient's condition.

rejected.label: Acute transverse myelitis
rejected.why: This condition is an inflammatory process, which is not indicated by the patient's history of trauma or the imaging findings.
